> (PR description is generated by AI tool)

## Motivation

`update_weights_from_tensor` on a bf16 MoE served with `--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm` (the non-routed runner) fails on the first expert copy:

```
RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (64) must match the size of tensor b (256) at non-singleton dimension 2
```

`UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod.process_weights_after_loading` packs `w13_weight` / `w2_weight` into the TRT-LLM block layout (`[E, 2I, H]` -> `[E, H/128, 2I, 128]`) for both `flashinfer_trtllm` and `flashinfer_trtllm_routed`. The only thing that undid it before a hot weight copy was `maybe_restore_flashinfer_trtllm_bf16_weight_shape_for_load` in `FusedMoE._weight_loader_impl`, and that helper is gated on `get_moe_runner_backend().is_flashinfer_trtllm_routed()` (#20214). On the non-routed runner it returns early, so the checkpoint-shaped `[I, H]` shard is copied into a 4-D block slice.

#40777 added the weight-update session (`begin_weight_update` -> `restore_weights_before_loading`, `end_weight_update` -> `postprocess_weights`) as the place where in-place repacks are undone and re-applied, but `UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod` still inherits the no-op `restore_weights_before_loading`, so the session does not restore the trtllm layout on either runner; the routed runner only worked because of the per-tensor helper.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/unquant.py`:

- Implement `UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod.restore_weights_before_loading`: when `use_flashinfer_trtllm_moe`, reshape `w13_weight` and `w2_weight` back to their load shapes. Shape only, as with the Marlin W4A16 MoE restore: the refit rewrites every expert and `end_weight_update`'s postprocess re-applies the block layout.
- Gate `maybe_restore_flashinfer_trtllm_bf16_weight_shape_for_load` on `self.use_flashinfer_trtllm_moe` (the flag that applied the layout) instead of the routed backend, and share the shape logic with the session hook. The per-tensor path stays for loads that run outside a session (`update_weights_from_disk`, IPC).

`test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_unquant_trtllm_bf16_moe_reload.py` (new, mirrors `test_compressed_tensors_wna16_moe_reload.py`; `base-b`, `1-gpu-small`): builds a bf16 `FusedMoE` under each trtllm runner, postprocesses it, then

- `test_session_restores_the_load_shape_and_finalize_repacks`: `begin_weight_update` hands back `[E, 2I, H]` / `[E, H, I]`, `end_weight_update` repacks.
- `test_refit_reproduces_a_fresh_load`: a session refit to a second checkpoint equals a fresh load of that checkpoint bit-for-bit and keeps the parameter `data_ptr`s (captured CUDA graphs keep reading the same buffers).

Neither test launches the trtllm-gen kernel, so they run on any CUDA GPU.

Before the fix (A100-40GB, torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.1, main @ 684fea8af3):

```
ERROR: test_refit_reproduces_a_fresh_load (backend='flashinfer_trtllm')
  RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (64) must match the size of tensor b (256) at non-singleton dimension 2
FAIL:  test_session_restores_the_load_shape_and_finalize_repacks (backend='flashinfer_trtllm')
FAIL:  test_session_restores_the_load_shape_and_finalize_repacks (backend='flashinfer_trtllm_routed')
  AssertionError: {'w13_weight': (4, 4, 512, 64), 'w2_weight': (4, 4, 256, 64)} != {'w13_weight': (4, 512, 256), 'w2_weight': (4, 256, 256)}
FAILED (failures=2, errors=1)
```

After:

```
Ran 2 tests in 1.498s
OK
```

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the forward path is unchanged. The refit test asserts the reloaded parameters are `torch.equal` to a fresh load on both runners.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the change runs once per weight-update session, outside the forward path.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+"""Refit of flashinfer_trtllm BF16 MoE experts must reproduce a fresh load on both runners."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner_components.weight_updater import (
+    WeightUpdater,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.loader import DefaultModelLoader
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_flags, get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.layer_ut_utils import init_single_process_dist
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+# The trtllm-gen block layout needs 128-aligned hidden and intermediate sizes.
+E, H, I, TOPK = 4, 256, 256, 2
+PREFIX = "model.layers.0.mlp.experts"
+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+CANONICAL_SHAPES = {"w13_weight": (E, 2 * I, H), "w2_weight": (E, H, I)}
+RUNNERS = (
+    MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_TRTLLM,
+    MoeRunnerBackend.FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_ROUTED,
+)
+
+
+def _random_checkpoint(seed):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    return {
+        (expert_id, shard_id): torch.randn(
+            rows, cols, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE, generator=gen
+        )
+        for expert_id in range(E)
+        for shard_id, (rows, cols) in (("w1", (I, H)), ("w3", (I, H)), ("w2", (H, I)))
+    }
+
+
+def _load(layer, shards):
+    for (expert_id, shard_id), tensor in shards.items():
+        name = "w2_weight" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13_weight"
+        # the dotted checkpoint name, as model.load_weights passes it
+        layer.weight_loader(
+            getattr(layer, name),
+            tensor,
+            f"{PREFIX}.{name}",
+            shard_id=shard_id,
+            expert_id=expert_id,
+        )
+
+
+def _shapes(layer):
+    return {name: tuple(getattr(layer, name).shape) for name in CANONICAL_SHAPES}
+
+
+class TestFlashinferTrtllmBf16MoeReload(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        init_single_process_dist(master_port=29634)
+        torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def _runtime(self, backend):
+        with (
+            get_context().override_server_args(model_path="dummy"),
+            get_flags().moe.override(runner_backend=backend),
+            get_parallel().override(
+                moe_ep_size=1,
+                moe_ep_rank=0,
+                moe_tp_size=1,
+                moe_tp_rank=0,
+                tp_size=1,
+                tp_rank=0,
+            ),
+        ):
+            yield
+
+    def _fresh_model(self, shards):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+
+        model = torch.nn.Module()
+        model.experts = FusedMoE(
+            num_experts=E,
+            hidden_size=H,
+            intermediate_size=I,
+            layer_id=0,
+            top_k=TOPK,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            prefix=PREFIX,
+        ).cuda()
+        _load(model.experts, shards)
+        DefaultModelLoader.postprocess_weights(model, DEVICE)
+        return model
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _updater(model):
+        # the component the scheduler drives for each runner in a session
+        return WeightUpdater(
+            tp_rank=0,
+            device="cuda",
+            gpu_id=0,
+            model_config=None,
+            custom_weight_loaders={},
+            get_model=lambda: model,
+            update_model_fields=None,
+            recapture_cuda_graph=None,
+            get_model_runner=None,
+        )
+
+    def _refit(self, model, shards):
+        updater = self._updater(model)
+        updater.begin_weight_update()
+        _load(model.experts, shards)
+        updater.end_weight_update(run_post_load=False)
+
+    def _assert_same_weights(self, model, expected):
+        expected_params = dict(expected.named_parameters())
+        for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(param, expected_params[name]),
+                f"{name} differs from a fresh load",
+            )
+
+    def test_session_restores_the_load_shape_and_finalize_repacks(self):
+        """begin_weight_update must hand back the checkpoint shapes on both trtllm runners;
+        end_weight_update must repack them. Before the restore hook existed the
+        non-routed runner left the block layout in place."""
+        for backend in RUNNERS:
+            with self.subTest(backend=backend.value), self._runtime(backend):
+                model = self._fresh_model(_random_checkpoint(1))
+                packed = _shapes(model.experts)
+                self.assertNotEqual(packed, CANONICAL_SHAPES)
+
+                updater = self._updater(model)
+                updater.begin_weight_update()
+                self.assertEqual(_shapes(model.experts), CANONICAL_SHAPES)
+                updater.end_weight_update(run_post_load=False)
+                self.assertEqual(_shapes(model.experts), packed)
+
+    def test_refit_reproduces_a_fresh_load(self):
+        """A checkpoint shard cannot be copied into the 4-D block layout; the routed runner
+        restored per tensor at load time, the non-routed one raised on the copy."""
+        for backend in RUNNERS:
+            with self.subTest(backend=backend.value), self._runtime(backend):
+                ckpt_a, ckpt_b = _random_checkpoint(1), _random_checkpoint(2)
+                fresh_a, fresh_b = self._fresh_model(ckpt_a), self._fresh_model(ckpt_b)
+                model = self._fresh_model(ckpt_a)
+                ptrs = {name: p.data_ptr() for name, p in model.named_parameters()}
+
+                self._refit(model, ckpt_b)
+                self._assert_same_weights(model, fresh_b)
+                self._refit(model, ckpt_a)
+                self._assert_same_weights(model, fresh_a)
+                # captured CUDA graphs keep reading the original buffers
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    {name: p.data_ptr() for name, p in model.named_parameters()}, ptrs
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
